description: The governed Twilio adapter of the Eclipse voice & telephony family, in V0 fixture form. Twilio ships the pipes (official MCP surfaces included); Trunk is the layer above them: raw carrier operations are never exposed, only a classified subset — Twilio-shaped log reads with numbers masked beyond last-4, simulated SMS sends, simulated human calls (a named human speaker is required; there is no AI voice in this adapter), number inventory search, registration status, and recording policy. Every send is gated through Eclipse Voice Core: live consent check first, then the Agent Wallet-shaped mandate, then Number Registry sendability; the family receipt carries the consent_record_id and the mandate verdict. Trunk holds no consent copies — it evaluates against the shared Voice Core state at check time, so a revocation refuses Trunk's very next send. V0 reaches no carrier: fixtures + a local stub only, nothing sent, nothing provisioned.
